Upstream comparison verified on 2026-09-15 against commit `de98ee4e268df1b44fa777f360aa58e241a7a635`:
https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-pair/blob/de98ee4e268df1b44fa777f360aa58e241a7a635/skills/marimo-pair/scripts/execute-code.sh

This is a session pairing transport, not an account-token generator or a cloud session creation API. Create sessions in the normal Molab UI after owner consent. The kernel/code-mode interface is private and may change; revalidate against the active notebook before heavy work.
